lines.gurmukhi: ਓਰੈ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਕਿਨਹੂ ਕੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: orai kachhoo na kinahoo keeaa ||
lines.translation: In this world, no one accomplishes anything by himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਹੂਆ ॥੫੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sabh kachh prabh te hooaa ||51||
lines.translation: O Nanak, everything is done by God. ||51||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੇਖੈ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਭੂਲਨਹਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: lekhai katahi na chhooteeai khin khin bhoolanahaar ||
lines.translation: Because of the balance due on his account, he can never be released; he makes mistakes each and every moment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਖਸਨਹਾਰ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bakhasanahaar bakhas lai naanak paar utaar ||1||
lines.translation: O Forgiving Lord, please forgive me, and carry Nanak across. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੂਣ ਹਰਾਮੀ ਗੁਨਹਗਾਰ ਬੇਗਾਨਾ ਅਲਪ ਮਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: loon haraamee gunahagaar begaanaa alap mat ||
lines.translation: The sinner is unfaithful to himself; he is ignorant, with shallow understanding.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸੁਖ ਦੀਏ ਤਾਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਨਤ ਤਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d jin sukh deee taahi na jaanat tat ||
lines.translation: He does not know the essence of all, the One who gave him body, soul and peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਹਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਨੇ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਢੂਢਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: laahaa maaiaa kaarane dah dis dhoodhan jaai ||
lines.translation: For the sake of personal profit and Maya, he goes out, searching in the ten directions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰ ਦਾਤਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਮਨਹਿ ਬਸਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: devanahaar daataar prabh nimakh na manahi basaai ||
lines.translation: He does not enshrine the Generous Lord God, the Great Giver, in his mind, even for an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਲਚ ਝੂਠ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮੋਹ ਇਆ ਸੰਪੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: laalach jhooth bikaar moh iaa sa(n)pai man maahi ||
lines.translation: Greed, falsehood, corruption and emotional attachment - these are what he collects within his mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੰਪਟ ਚੋਰ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਮਹਾ ਤਿਨਹੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਿਹਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: la(n)pat chor ni(n)dak mahaa tinahoo sa(n)g bihaai ||
lines.translation: The worst perverts, thieves and slanderers - he passes his time with them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਖੋਟੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਖਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tudh bhaavai taa bakhas laihi khote sa(n)g khare ||
lines.translation: But if it pleases You, Lord, then You forgive the counterfeit along with the genuine.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਾਵੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਾਹਨ ਨੀਰਿ ਤਰੇ ॥੫੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bhaavai paarabraham paahan neer tare ||52||
lines.translation: O Nanak, if it pleases the Supreme Lord God, then even a stone will float on water. ||52||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਾਤ ਪੀਤ ਖੇਲਤ ਹਸਤ ਭਰਮੇ ਜਨਮ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: khaat peet khelat hasat bharame janam anek ||
lines.translation: Eating, drinking, playing and laughing, I have wandered through countless incarnations.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਵਜਲ ਤੇ ਕਾਢਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bhavajal te kaadhahu prabhoo naanak teree tek ||1||
lines.translation: Please, God, lift me up and out of the terrifying world-ocean. Nanak seeks Your Support. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੇਲਤ ਖੇਲਤ ਆਇਓ ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: khelat khelat aaio anik jon dukh paai ||
lines.translation: Playing, playing, I have been reincarnated countless times, but this has only brought pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੇਦ ਮਿਟੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਮਿਲਤ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: khed mite saadhoo milat satigur bachan samaai ||
lines.translation: Troubles are removed, when one meets with the Holy; immerse yourself in the Word of the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿਮਾ ਗਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਚਿਓ ਖਾਇਓ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: khimaa gahee sach sa(n)chio khaaio a(n)mrit naam ||
lines.translation: Adopting an attitude of tolerance, and gathering truth, partake of the Ambrosial Nectar of the Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਈ ਅਨਦ ਸੂਖ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: kharee kripaa thaakur bhaee anad sookh bisraam ||
lines.translation: When my Lord and Master showed His Great Mercy, I found peace, happiness and bliss.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੇਪ ਨਿਬਾਹੀ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਲਾਭ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ਪਤਿਵੰਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: khep nibaahee bahut laabh ghar aae pativa(n)t ||
lines.translation: My merchandise has arrived safely, and I have made a great profit; I have returned home with honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਰਾ ਦਿਲਾਸਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: kharaa dilaasaa gur deeaa aai mile bhagava(n)t ||
lines.translation: The Guru has given me great consolation, and the Lord God has come to meet me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਨ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਆਗੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਆਪਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapan keeaa karahi aap aagai paachhai aap ||
lines.translation: He Himself has acted, and He Himself acts. He was in the past, and He shall be in the future.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਊ ਸਰਾਹੀਐ ਜਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਿਆਪਿ ॥੫੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sooo saraaheeai j ghat ghat rahiaa biaap ||53||
lines.translation: O Nanak, praise the One, who is contained in each and every heart. ||53||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਨਾਗਤੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: aae prabh saranaagatee kirapaa nidh daiaal ||
lines.translation: O God, I have come to Your Sanctuary, O Merciful Lord, Ocean of compassion.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਅਖਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਬਸਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਹੋਤ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ek akhar har man basat naanak hot nihaal ||1||
lines.translation: One whose mind is filled with the One Word of the Lord, O Nanak, becomes totally blissful. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਖਰ ਮਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: akhar mahi tribhavan prabh dhaare ||
lines.translation: In the Word, God established the three worlds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਖਰ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: akhar kar kar bed beechaare ||
lines.translation: Created from the Word, the Vedas are contemplated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਖਰ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪੁਰਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: akhar saasatr si(n)mrit puraanaa ||
lines.translation: From the Word, came the Shaastras, Simritees and Puraanas.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਖਰ ਨਾਦ ਕਥਨ ਵਖੵਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: akhar naad kathan vakhyaanaa ||
lines.translation: From the Word, came the sound current of the Naad, speeches and explanations.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਖਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਭੈ ਭਰਮਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: akhar mukat jugat bhai bharamaa ||
lines.translation: From the Word, comes the way of liberation from fear and doubt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਖਰ ਕਰਮ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਸੁਚ ਧਰਮਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: akhar karam kirat such dharamaa ||
lines.translation: From the Word, come religious rituals, karma, sacredness and Dharma.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿਮਾਨ ਅਖਰ ਹੈ ਜੇਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: drisatimaan akhar hai jetaa ||
lines.translation: In the visible universe, the Word is seen.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਿਰਲੇਪਾ ॥੫੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak paarabraham niralepaa ||54||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Supreme Lord God remains unattached and untouched. ||54||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਥਿ ਕਲੰਮ ਅਗੰਮ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਾਵਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: hath kala(n)m aga(n)m masatak likhaavatee ||
lines.translation: With pen in hand, the Inaccessible Lord writes man's destiny on his forehead.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਰਝਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪਾਵਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: urajh rahio sabh sa(n)g anoop roopaavatee ||
lines.translation: The Lord of Incomparable Beauty is involved with all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਤੁਹਾਰੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: usatat kahan na jaai mukhahu tuhaareeaa ||
lines.translation: I cannot describe Your Praises with my mouth, O Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: mohee dekh daras naanak balihaareeaa ||1||
lines.translation: Nanak is fascinated, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; he is a sacrifice to You. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਅਚੁਤ ਹੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਘਨਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: he achut he paarabraham abinaasee aghanaas ||
lines.translation: O Immovable Lord, O Supreme Lord God, Imperishable, Destroyer of sins:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੇ ਸਰਬ ਮੈ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: he pooran he sarab mai dukh bha(n)jan gunataas ||
lines.translation: O Perfect, All-pervading Lord, Destroyer of pain, Treasure of virtue:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਸੰਗੀ ਹੇ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਹੇ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਸਭ ਟੇਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: he sa(n)gee he nira(n)kaar he niragun sabh tek ||
lines.translation: O Companion, Formless, Absolute Lord, Support of all:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਹੇ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਦਾ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: he gobid he gun nidhaan jaa kai sadaa bibek ||
lines.translation: O Lord of the Universe, Treasure of excellence, with clear eternal understanding:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਹਿ ਭੀ ਹੋਵਨਹਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: he apara(n)par har hare hahi bhee hovanahaar ||
lines.translation: Most Remote of the Remote, Lord God: You are, You were, and You shall always be.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਸੰਤਹ ਕੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਧਾਰਾ ਆਧਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: he sa(n)tah kai sadaa sa(n)g nidhaaraa aadhaar ||
lines.translation: O Constant Companion of the Saints, You are the Support of the unsupported.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਉ ਦਾਸਰੋ ਮੈ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਗੁਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: he thaakur hau daasaro mai niragun gun nahee koi ||
lines.translation: O my Lord and Master, I am Your slave. I am worthless, I have no worth at all.
